items.html:
Updated lattice properties in checks.rs, mod.rs, plus explanatory comments in strategies.rs and tables.rs.

  • Unsupported draws explicitly assert InvalidInput for Ewald values and derivatives; generators, regression seeds, reference values, and tolerances are preserved.
  • Supported real/near-real derivative checks now run with probes inside the domain; spherical negative-real rejection is also exercised.
  • rustfmt and git diff --check pass. Native tests remain for the parent’s coordinated lattice run. No commits.
